figures.name: Paramashiva

ability.name: Pure Consciousness
ability.description: All ally abilities cost 0 energy this turn; enemy abilities that limit consciousness auto-fail.

figures.description: The supreme absolute of Kashmir Shaivism — pure undivided consciousness from which all reality emanates.

figures.name: Shakti-Para

ability.name: Divine Vibration
ability.description: Deal 5 damage to all enemies; grant all allies +2 to all stats from Shakti's emanation.

figures.description: The supreme Shakti of Kashmiri Shaivism — the inseparable creative power of Paramashiva.

figures.name: Abhinavagupta

ability.name: Pratybhijna Teaching
ability.description: Grant all allies recognition of their own highest potential: +3 wisdom for 2 turns.

figures.description: The supreme philosopher-mystic of Kashmir Shaivism whose Tantraloka synthesized all tantric wisdom.

figures.name: Bhairava (Kashmir)

ability.name: Absolute Terror
ability.description: Force all enemies to face their ultimate fear: each loses 2 of their highest stat.

figures.description: The supreme manifestation of Bhairava in Kashmiri Shaivism representing the terrifying face of liberation.

figures.name: Trika Shakti

ability.name: Triple Goddess
ability.description: Activate three abilities simultaneously for one ally as the Triple Goddess empowers them.

figures.description: The three goddesses of the Trika system representing the threefold nature of divine consciousness.

figures.name: Kshemaraja

ability.name: Recognition Sutra
ability.description: Grant one ally permanent immunity to confusion effects; they know their true nature.

figures.description: The greatest disciple of Abhinavagupta who wrote the Pratyabhijnahrdayam — the Heart of Recognition.

figures.name: Spanda (Force)

ability.name: Cosmic Pulse
ability.description: All timing abilities on your side trigger at the perfect moment for 2 turns.

figures.description: The fundamental vibrating creative pulse of divine consciousness that creates and sustains all reality.

figures.name: Aghora

ability.name: Forbidden Rite
ability.description: Ignore all game rules for one ability; it works as if no defense or immunity exists.

figures.description: The terrible Aghora face of Shiva worshipped by those who seek liberation through transgression of limits.

figures.name: Matrikas

ability.name: Eight Mothers
ability.description: Grant eight different +1 stat bonuses distributed among all allies.

figures.description: The eight Mother Goddesses of Kashmiri Shaivism who embody the letters of the Sanskrit alphabet as creative power.

figures.name: Svacchanda Bhairava

ability.name: Self-Willed Power
ability.description: This card ignores all restriction abilities; it acts freely at all times.

figures.description: The five-faced 'Self-Willed' Bhairava who embodies absolute divine freedom and unlimited self-expression.

figures.name: Natha Siddha

ability.name: Shaktipat
ability.description: Transmit awakening to one ally: grant them +3 to all stats permanently.

figures.description: The awakened yogic master who has received shaktipat initiation and transmits divine awakening to students.

figures.name: Anuttara

ability.name: Unsurpassable
ability.description: This card's power cannot be reduced below its original value by any means.

figures.description: The Unsurpassable — the absolute reality in Kashmiri Shaivism that underlies and pervades all existence.

figures.name: Kuleshvara

ability.name: Kula Initiation
ability.description: One ally gains access to a forbidden ability that was previously sealed.

figures.description: The lord of the tantric Kula tradition who initiates adepts into the secret family of divine realization.

figures.name: Virupa

ability.name: Transgressive Grace
ability.description: This card ignores all moral restrictions; deal 4 damage that bypasses alignment defenses.

figures.description: The Kashmiri tantric siddha who attained liberation through the transgressive practice of wine and fish eating.

figures.name: Bindu

ability.name: Zero Point
ability.description: Collapse all field effects to zero; all cards return to base stats.

figures.description: The primordial point of divine consciousness from which the entire universe of Kashmir Shaivism emanates.

figures.name: Nada

ability.name: Cosmic Sound
ability.description: All sound and music abilities gain +3 power; one enemy is disoriented by cosmic vibration.

figures.description: The primordial sound-vibration that precedes all manifestation in Kashmir Shaivism's creation teaching.

figures.name: Lalla Ded

ability.name: Naked Freedom
ability.description: Remove all material buffs and debuffs from this card; gain +5 magic from pure spiritual freedom.

figures.description: The 14th century Kashmiri mystic poetess who wandered naked expressing Shaiva liberation in profound verses.

figures.name: Prana

ability.name: Life Breath
ability.description: Restore 2 HP to all allies; all paralysis and stun effects end.

figures.description: The divine life breath (Prana) that carries the energy of Shiva's consciousness through all living beings.

figures.name: Uttara Kaula

ability.name: Ultimate Secret
ability.description: Grant one ally access to the most powerful sealed ability on the field.

figures.description: The most advanced Kaula tantric transmission — the supreme secret teaching of the Kashmiri tradition.

figures.name: Kali (Kashmir)

ability.name: Time Collapse
ability.description: All timing-based enemy abilities are nullified; time itself stops for enemies for 1 turn.

figures.description: The Kashmiri tantric form of Kali who represents the dissolution of all mental constructs in timeless awareness.
